title: [last dev] Crash during Carbs entries Calculator or Carbs button
body:
I don't know if it's a side effect of https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/dcf3c9cc57b0a2b63af9ee418dafee82fefef95b but this morning my carbs entered in CALCULATOR was not recorded in database (see screenshot and log) (First time I see missing carbs in database)
[AndroidAPS._2021-11-08_08-41-23_.0.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7495715/AndroidAPS._2021-11-08_08-41-23_.0.zip)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/140717535-7d4bacdc-6d46-4993-bbc3-0d83af81fcaa.png)

comments.body:
Very strange in log file the line before crash is:
```
08:41:25.862 [main] D/PUMP: [OmnipodDashPodStateManagerImpl.load():665]: Creating new Pod state
```
Could it be the reason of the crash ? (How can I have this line `Creating new Pod state` from Dash driver with Insight driver selected...)
Got a crash when I tried to manually enter Carbs from Carbs button with the same strange OmnipodDash line before

Confirmed, with dev from 00:12 AM
If I try to enter carbs, AAPS crashed, restarted and Carbs are not entered. Tryed again with same result.
System:
Pixel 5  phone, Combo pump, AAPS 2.8.2.9 created and installed at 00:12 AM.

This happened in any case that you use for enter carbs, (wizard with insulin and carbs, manual).
If you use the wizard to enter insulin and carbs, then insulin was delivered and entered, then AAPS crashed without enter the cabs too.

The dev before this version was fine.

I confirm the missing carbs too @MilosKozak.
Latest dev built this morning

![Screenshot_20211108-093312_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/140736283-1a3f6ddc-cbb2-416d-b731-5cee0f7c25d1.jpg)
 
At noon I use the wizard to calculate and inject my bolus. The insulin and the calc line are in treatments but not the carbs. I saw that something was wrong when my 2nd graph showed onlt IOB and no COB. I didn't have a crash.

![Screenshot_20211108-124006_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/140736593-1f04d8a2-d12a-4523-a437-0d7f59b4a0f4.jpg)

![Screenshot_20211108-124036_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/140736659-20fa61b0-b32a-4e31-a69b-21103abd9860.jpg)

Then, I manually entered the carbs and had the crash.

Meal at 12:19 (missing carbs), manual carbs added ar 12:49 resulting in the crash.
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1636372202286.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7496710/AndroidAPS_LOG_1636372202286.log.zip)

I had something like this happen today except it was with DASH pod and the 3.2.0-beta1. I will try to get logs and screen snapshots next time. I have been testing AAPS on and off for over a month for my son. First time such a thing happened.
